notes.title: The Third Devil Lord – Xiwangmu Arrives!
notes.content:
[b][h3]Dear Overlords, we are excited to welcome the arrival of the third Devil Lord – Xiwangmu![/h3][/b]

She is one of the most significant figures in Chinese mythology, governing the secrets of immortality and is an ancient goddess capable of bringing health and prosperity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/fc68456be6f41a66adcff569cd14b447dc263044.jpg[/img]

This time, she will lead the gods and Yaoguais of Chinese mythology to descend upon the Devil’s Castle and drive away the uninvited guests attempting to steal the Treasures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/94479e5160ceed0b6d5be9bd7ea3d7cb756544bf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/281a7a7617aa39faaa1109b3abba27fc525f83f6.gif[/img]

Additionally, there’s more exciting news to share with everyone!

How would you like to defend your treasures with an adorable squad of Monster Girls?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/015cc2b2c3b2523cb766d7c1a1fede2fe3e57011.png[/img]

[b]The "Supporter Pack" DLC for Endgame of Devil is now available![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180540/_/

This supporter pack includes Monster Girl skins for 45 Minions:

[b][h3]Barbatos[/h3][/b]
Fire Imp, Poison Imp, Blue Devil, Candle Demon, Darksaber, Blood Servant, Slime, Ghost Captain, Blood Mage, Fire Dragon, Thunder Dragon, Shoggoth, Lich, Chaos Lord, Shub-Niggurath

[b][h3]Frankenstein[/h3][/b]
Old Mummy, Student, Supervisory Unit, Thief, Burnt Corpse, Star Demon, Gnome, Dwarf Guard, Dwarf Miner, Lord of Tides, Zombie Bear, Griffin, Angler, Laplace's Demon, Phoenix

[b][h3]Xiwangmu[/h3][/b]
Giant Clam, Pugilist Master, Ghost Blade, Swordsmith, Jade Sculptor, Stone Tablet, Cursed Statue, Impermanence, Red-Haired Yaksha, Tomb Spirit, Jade Golem, Jade Loong, White Elephant, Qing Lion, Jing Wei

[h3][b]This DLC also includes a Special Treasure: Golden Egg[/b][/h3]

[b]Golden Egg[/b]
Click to remove this Treasure and gain 1 copies of the selected Minion and 1 random Legendary Adventurer.

[b](Click the icon located at the bottom-left of the regular mode)[/b]

Enjoy a 14-day discount, and we hope you have fun! Don’t forget to recommend it to your friends!

notes.title: Adventurers are no longer sitting ducks! Bloody Battle mode is now live!
notes.content:
In this mode, Adventurers won't just passively take attacks anymore, but will fight back against Minions!

Minions’ HP are based on their rarity. You can use Refresh to heal your Minions, and Removal to seal an Adventurer's ability!

So, how many rounds can you Devil Lords defend against such challenges?

On top of that, there are other balance adjustments, please see below:


[b]Balance Adjustment[/b]

[list]
[*] For Barbatos, the basic damage of [Shadow Ball], [Fire Ball], [Blood Arrow], and [Thunderstorm] has been increased.
[*] For Barbatos, Minions [Skeleton Saber], [Water Elemental], [Bugbear], and [Medusa] have been enhanced, and Treasures [Chaos Bomb] and [Ghost Ship] have been enhanced.
[*] In Regular Mode, early kills no longer provide additional [Removal].
[/list]


[b]Improvement and Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Modified the English description text of some Minions.
[*] The Minions [Mud Monster] now works correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: 《Endgame of Devil》Lunar New Year update is here!
notes.content:
Dear Devil Lords, the Lunar New Year is approaching, yet those greedy Adventurers show no signs of resting! We have hereby recruited a new Minion: The Nian Beast! A monster feared in Chinese mythology!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/261d635b8d1f124b9a44a59931e7cd4225e36ced.gif[/img]

In the Far East, the New Year is followed by the Lantern Festival, where people celebrate by eating dumplings. Treat your Minions to a meal too! A good feast makes for a stronger fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/0c9fdb6922362042bd176261d526adf09b5522fc.gif[/img]


By the way, the hated Sacred Golem that everyone disliked has been nerfed and won't keep popping up to take up space anymore!

You may refer to the 'Balance Adjustment' section below for more details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/1407713e0296d3717f879bf025d1472207a8e636.png[/img]


[b]Lunar New Year Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Minion for Frankenstein: Nian Beast.
[*] New Treasure for Frankenstein: Dumpling.
[*] New Endless Treasures for Frankenstein: Powerful Bullet, Electricity Gem, and Maple Leaf.
[*] The Ring “Blade” is replaced by “Conversion”, and it can convert Removal into Refresh.
[/list]


[b]Game Difficulty Adjustment:[/b]
[list]
[*] In Normal Mode, Adventurers’ HP is decreased in wave 1 and 2 but increased in waves 6 to 14.
[*] At Levels 11 to 20, Adventurers’ HP is further increased.
[*] For the Level 20, "Allied Flag" has been reworked and enhanced.
[*] The Minion, "Sacred Golem" has also been reworked; its current effect is “Self-remove when nearby Adventurer's HP turns to 0.”
[/list]

notes.title: Devil Lords! Christmas Update Is Here
notes.content:
Dear Devil Lords, Christmas is coming, and there is something strange going on with the Minions. Frankenstein's 'Saplings' are restless and look like they will be changing shape in the near future! Please be prepared!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/5fd64f74a080dfe667a64df3aad7d6a3a66663bd.gif[/img]

Of course, there are holiday gifts awaiting you. When you play as Frankenstein, don't hesitate to open the gift we've prepared – you'll love it!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/67f05610da64ba0005b8f825dc92de290c4e6702.gif[/img]

Some of the Minions have been reworked or adjusted, and Frankenstein will be joining the Endless Invasion, bringing along new treasures. Details can be found below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/853974365fb4e620b3957ad617fc58067fbfdcfd.png[/img]

In addition to the above content, the following adjustments will be made:
[list]
[*] In Endless Invasion, health of Adventurers after wave 14 will increase, but their numbers will be reduced.
[*] n the regular mode, the chance of obtaining high-quality Minions will increase in waves 11 and 12, and health of Adventurers in waves 13 and 14 will be increased.
[*] Frankenstein version can now be unlocked immediately upon first entering the game.
[*] In Frankenstein version, the colors of some special effects have been adjusted.
[/list]

notes.title: Endgame of Devil's Upcoming Update in July
notes.content:
[b]Devil Lords, here is good news!
The new content we are preparing for you will be updated in July! And let’s have a look at what's the exciting challenge that's awaiting us.[/b]

[olist]
[*] [b]New Difficulty[/b]

We will add new difficulties of levels 14 to 20. Each level has a unique adventurer treasure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/b76a14a0d8c16b6e1c3a0e490a3c0c15f999e29f.png[/img]

[*] [b]The Rings System[/b]

In the new version, you will obtain Soul Shards in the game, and use them to unlock and wear different Rings.

At the beginning of the game, you can carry up to 3 Rings with corresponding buffs, which will give you a helping hand!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/79900631b22b79830507f51203737c6059993205.png[/img]

[*] [b]The “Endless Invasion” Mode[/b]

In Endless Invasion Mode, you will face countless adventurers that keep coming for your treasures. Summon the minions and prepare for the battle!

After certain rounds, you will have the chance to get minions or treasures that are exclusive to the Endless Invasion Mode!

The adventurer treasure will rotate daily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/57be470b35ded6738c3931e82f80b1736dfd2c16.png[/img]

[*] [b]Support More Languages[/b][/olist][list]
[*] The game will support English and Traditional Chinese! More players across the world can enjoy the game together![/list]
————————————————————————————————————————————————————

[h3]More exciting news! Another update is on the agenda![/h3]

[b]The new Devil Lord, Frankenstein, the creation of mad science and frightening existence, is coming soon!

We'll be waiting for you in September![/b]

notes.title: 【魔王终局】游戏内容更新
notes.content:
[h1]新内容[/h1]

[h3]单局扩展[/h3]
游戏的总波次由12更改为14，其中在第7波和14波时，魔王将遭遇强有力的精英冒险者和传奇冒险者，击败精英冒险者将掉落独特且通用的传奇财宝。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/6449ea07f76afc8d96b1556a0e52bf3b5759603c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/ef1475d2fdda1af532858653baa3536a1f199181.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/bf673d825b4b803902275efa5241b41cfcc4616c.png[/img]

[h3]难度扩展[/h3]
游戏再原有10个难度基础上，再添3个难度，并搭配有3个全新的难度财宝，带来更多的挑战！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/2d295cc01b1e974f1246cbdf59c30b87527f9c5a.png[/img]

[h3]游戏体验优化[/h3]
①现在提前击杀冒险者时，还会根据剩余计时，获得等值的消除术。
②修复了一些BUG

[h3]接下来的更新计划[/h3]
新财宝，无尽模式，局外养成，第二位魔王......我们也将持续对游戏体验进行优化！



再次感谢那些支持我们、鞭策我们的玩家！你们的建议和反馈非常宝贵！
如果的大家有Bug反馈，游戏建议等，欢迎加入我们的官方群QQ482293229，随时告诉我们！我们将竭尽全力来优化和完善游戏。

notes.title: 《魔王终局》优化补丁说明
notes.content:
以下为此次优化补丁的具体内容：

[h3]游戏开局[/h3]
游戏开局的冒险者血量曲线进一步优化，树妖被从开局队伍中剔除，换成了其他更为稳定的远程随从。

[h3]UI显示[/h3]
①现在随从棋子包可以在两种显示模式中切换：同一种随从堆叠或是分开;且现在棋子包按钮上会显示随从总数。
②财宝中，火焰电池增加计数器
③修复了当六个Buff效果都出现于顶端时，和右侧难度栏堆叠的问题。

[h3]交互[/h3]
点击开始游戏后的默认难度将变为上次选择的难度，而非最高难度。

[h3]其他[/h3]
①刷新术和消除术的上限增加到99。
②强化了暗影弹的显示效果

新内容（传奇冒险者队伍、新难度等）预计将在下月上线。而在这之前，我们也会持续对平衡性和交互进行优化！

再再次感谢那些支持我们、鞭策我们的玩家！你们的建议和反馈非常宝贵！
如果的大家有Bug反馈，游戏建议等，欢迎加入我们的官方群QQ482293229，随时告诉我们！我们将竭尽全力来优化和完善游戏。

notes.title: 《魔王终局》此次更新内容
notes.content:
Undate

[h1]此次的更新内容[/h1]

在收到大家踊跃的建议和反馈后，我们决定调整游戏随机性和策略性的比重，让玩家能够有更多的操作空间，更方便的去构筑自己的梦幻阵容。
现在每波结束后获得财宝时，可以选择使用两次刷新术进行财宝刷新！

[h2]加入了五个新财宝[/h2]
爆炸箭：血色箭击中时，会同时对目标相邻的冒险者造成伤害
押送头目：【计时8】获得1个神圣魔像和1个随机史诗随从
火焰电池：每有5个火球被释放，对所有敌人造成5点伤害
暗影符文：暗影弹击中时额外造成2次伤害
龙骨：【计时3】所有场上的火龙和雷龙攻击力永久+9

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/cabb6aeafd4219b40eff5bfb0f4c3ea678a7bb0d.png[/img]

[h2]部分财宝和随从增强[/h2]
①和随从关联的财宝，以及一些较为弱势的财宝获得了增强。
②某些过于弱势的随从获得了增强。

[h2]难度调整和机制优化[/h2]
①所有难度下，前期波次的冒险者血量被削弱。
②提高了冒险者掉落刷新术和消除术的概率。
③高品质随从的获取概率提升。
④现在财宝选项可以刷新。
⑤冒险者中，猎魔人遭到了削弱。

[h2]新的敌人和队伍构成机制[/h2]
①每个波次的冒险者队伍现在会遵循某种机制随机生成，而非固定几种构成。
②加入了9种新冒险者。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/8121cdb183943159d24fa67a2c53da513fc5a955.png[/img]

[h2]交互优化[/h2]
①增加按键提示，现在鼠标悬停于某些按钮时，会显示其用途。
②增加重开的按钮。
③游戏现在可以在后台运行。
④按回车或者空格可以一键开始战斗。

[h1]下次计划更新的内容[/h1]
①局外养成系统。
②更加丰富的单局游戏内容，固定的决策时机，特殊的波次。
③新财宝，进一步丰富玩法。
④机制更加有趣，难度更高的关卡。
⑤强力独特的英雄级冒险者。
⑥交互上的优化，如：游戏失败界面中加入重开按钮，棋子包中随从单独显示
⑦视觉效果的优化。


[u]再再次感谢那些支持我们、鞭策我们的玩家！你们的建议和反馈非常宝贵！[/u]
如果的大家有Bug反馈，游戏建议等，欢迎加入我们的官方群QQ482293229，随时告诉我们！我们将竭尽全力来优化和完善游戏

notes.title: Update Plan
notes.content:
大家好！

今天是迷你鲸工作室发布首款独立游戏《魔王终局》的第4天！

自发售后，《魔王终局》得到了不少玩家的喜爱和支持，同时也收到了不少关于游戏的宝贵建议和真实反馈。我们在整理和协商后，确认了一些接下来的优化方向和内容开发计划，以期能为大家带来更好的体验以及更多新内容。

[h1]近期的更新计划[/h1]
[b]首先是接下来会在短期内加入的更新和修正，其将会在[u]下周[/u]与大家见面：[/b]

[b]①财宝机制和新财宝[/b]
1.那些和随从直接关联的财宝，将获得增强。
2.财宝在获取时，选项将可以消耗刷新术对选项进行刷新。
3.加入一些新的财宝。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/d35a09c95a79f7d66003919646f7396b7c52503d.png[/img]

[b]②冒险者的强度调整[/b]
1.冒险者队伍的构成将采用新的机制，而不再是固定的队伍。
2.更高难度中，冒险者的生命值增长将有所降低。
3.猎魔人将遭到削弱。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/41c77ead2837057d32b14d4a62ca99a9a2e21f53.png[/img]

[b]③随从增强[/b]
1.一些较为弱势的随从将得到增强。

[b]④调整和优化[/b]
1.将修正一些BUG，以及一些描述的进一步规范化。
2.鼠标悬停至一些按钮上时，将会在右下角显示其用途。
3.将加入一些交互上的优化。



[h1]后续开发计划[/h1]
这次更新之后，我们后续开发计划的关键内容如下：

[b]①个性化的局外养成[/b]

我们将尽快加入和设置局外养成机制，玩家们可以通过游戏获取资源用以强化魔王，以期在面对冒险者们有更多的胜算。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/2b0be5e2527a8fe120cb2a6a58e1197c0b7dfd3c.png[/img]

[b]②更多高难度挑战，Boss级别的敌人[/b]

一些强大且有独特机制的英雄，他们不同于以往的冒险者，并且将会在未来加入抢夺宝石的队列...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/fb6f28014d178dc9541c76b4415275a51ce4283f.png[/img]

[b]③新的财宝[/b]

在向大家展示了《魔王终局》的核心玩法后，接下来我们将以此为基底，将更多的内容融入，为大家带来更多样化，更有意思，更加极限的挑战。

新的财宝将会为大家带来更多的队伍搭配，并会对部分弱势流派或随从进行一定的补强；同时会加入一些更具有双面性的财宝，丰富的报酬与极高的风险并存！

[b]④新的魔王！[/b]
新的敌人，自然也有新的魔王！“疯狂科学家”

除部分“通用随从”外，他将拥有一批崭新的随从，并带来全新的流派，种族和机制！以及一批配套的专属财宝！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841609/35a528d7ca8366dd90a7ededacee76905d2a45d4.png[/img]
 

[b]⑤交互和界面UI优化[/b]
未来我们会对主界面以及魔王选择，局外养成等界面进行优化，为大家带来更好的沉浸感。

此处为大致的内容，我们将会在下周的更新后着手对具体的时间节点进行公示，并进行更详细的说明。

  

[u][b]再次感谢那些支持我们、鞭策我们的玩家！你们的建议和反馈非常宝贵！[/b][/u]
如果的大家有Bug反馈，游戏建议等，可以加入我们的官方群QQ482293229，随时告诉我们！我们将竭尽全力来优化和完善游戏！
